## 4. Architecture decisions (§14)

| AD | Invariant | Enforcement point | Tests that turn red on violation | Story | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AD-1 | Module dependency graph is AD-1's | Each module imports only neighbours' `index.ts`; `catalog` imports no module; admin guard lives in `server/trpc` | `SYS-AD1` | 1.4 (done) | green |
| AD-2 | Three facts, no custody | Fact CHECKs on `"Order"`; no balance/escrow/payment column | `ORD-2.I2`, `ORD-1.I4` | 7.1 (backlog), 7.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-3 | Commission balance is the single source of purchasability | Fail-closed `SellerCommissionState` read `FOR SHARE` at listing insert; projection seq gate | `INV-2.I2`, `INV-3.I2` | 5.1 (backlog), 5.5 (backlog) | red |
| AD-4 | Trading is a one-way flow off `listings` | `CHECK (sellerKindAtCreation='individual' OR NOT openToTrade)`; `getTradeability` / `reserveForTrade` ports | `INV-2.I4`, `TRD-1.I1` | 5.3 (backlog), 10.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-5 | One location query path | One SQL builder with no seller-kind branch | `DSC-1.I1` | 6.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-6 | `InventoryUnit` is the sole quantity owner | `CHECK (quantity >= 0)`; conditional decrement | `INV-1.I1`, `INV-1.MEC` | 5.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-7 | Catalog, listing and binder records are independent | Upsert `SET` list without `id`/`kind`; tagged-union CHECKs | `CAT-2.I3`, `COL-3.I2` | 4.2 (backlog), 11.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-8 | Table ownership | No module writes another's tables; static scan of `infra/` SQL; shared-kernel owns only infra tables (+ `audit_events`, R-2) | `SYS-AD8`, `S-FR-COL-3.h` | 1.4 (done), 11.5 (backlog) | green + red |
| AD-9 | Snapshot payloads | Payload = ADD-§5 exactly; subscribers read only the payload | `SYS-AD9`, `COL-2.I2` | 1.3 (done), 11.3 (backlog) | green + red |
| AD-10 | Post-commit, in-process dispatch with an outbox | `outbox.enqueue(tx)` + sweeper | `SYS-2.R6` | 1.3 (done) | red |
| AD-11 | One owner per error code | Registry `owner`; `raise` checks the caller module | `SYS-1.R2` | 1.1 (done) | red |
| AD-12 | Hide, never delete | `DELETE` revoked on `Review` and `Listing`; `hiddenAt IS NULL` default predicate | `REP-2.I1`, `DSC-1.I2` | 6.2 (backlog), 13.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-13 | `legalIdentity` under Ley 1581 | Split table; one repository reader | `VER-3.I2`, `IDN-3.I1` | 2.5 (done), 3.4 (done) | red |
| AD-14 | Signed URLs, 10-minute TTL | `ObjectStorage.sign(key, 600)` | `VER-3.I3` | 3.4 (done) | red |
| AD-15 | Business sees an order from `buyerPaidConfirmedAt` | One visibility predicate | `ORD-3.I3`, `ORD-3.MEC` | 7.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-16 | Roles derived server-side | `deriveCapabilities`; no role-like input key | `IDN-2.I1`, `SYS-8.R2` | 1.1 (done), 2.3 (done) | red |
| AD-17 | Comprobante is regulated data | `regulated.ts` + redactor; promotion through quarantine | `S-FR-ORD-2.f`, `SYS-8.R4` | 1.2 (done), 7.1 (backlog) | red |
| AD-18 | Exclusivity by rejecting the second state-granting action | Conditional `UPDATE "User"."sellerTrack"`; composite FKs | `IDN-1.MEC` | 2.2 (done) | red |
| AD-19 | Atomic decrement; balance may go negative | Account `UPDATE … RETURNING`; no refusal path | `COM-1.MEC` | 8.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-SYS-1 | One Decision shape and one code registry | `codes.ts`; error formatter; `explain_assert` | `SYS-1.R6` | 1.1 (done) | red |
| AD-SYS-2 | Transactional outbox; at most 3 automatic attempts | `EventDelivery` attempt procedure | `SYS-2.R4` | 1.3 (done) | red |
| AD-SYS-3 | Commission triggered by the first of two order events | `commissionTrigger(facts)`; partial unique on deductions | `COM-1.I4` | 8.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-SYS-4 | Transaction handles, pooler-safe state, global lock order | `tx` first; `db()` ambient client; ascending unit locks | `INV-1.I3`, `SYS-4.R9` | 2.3 (done), 5.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-SYS-5 | Every transition is one conditional UPDATE | `WHERE <from-state>` + loser re-read | `VER-1.MEC`, `TRD-2.I3` | 3.2 (done), 10.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-SYS-6 | Determinism boundary (Clock, IdGenerator, no network) | `Clock` port; network guard; no SQL `now()` | `SYS-6.R1`, `SYS-6.R4` | 1.4 (done) | green |
| AD-SYS-7 | Branded money, one set of formulas | BigInt helpers; rounding CHECK on deductions | `COM-1.I3`, `VAL-2.I3` | 8.2 (backlog), 12.5 (backlog) | red |
| AD-SYS-8 | Server-side authorization, regulated data, uploads | Procedure builders; redactor; quarantine promotion | `SYS-8.R2`, `VER-2.P3` | 1.1 (done), 3.3 (done) | red |
| AD-IDN-1 | Capabilities from one pure function | `deriveCapabilities`; trace = projection | `IDN-3.I3` | 2.5 (done) | red |
| AD-IDN-2 | Seller-track exclusivity | Conditional `UPDATE "User"."sellerTrack"` | `IDN-1.I1` | 2.2 (done) | red |
| AD-IDN-3 | `canBuy` gate and auth throttle | `requireCanBuy`; `AuthThrottleEvent` count | `S-FR-IDN-7.f` | 2.4 (done) | red |
| AD-VER-1 | One decision with its audit row and event | `WHERE status='Pending'`; unique decision log | `VER-1.I1` | 3.2 (done) | red |
| AD-VER-2 | Legal identity has one reader; reads and denials logged | `legalIdentityRepository`; access log | `VER-3.I1` | 3.4 (done) | red |
| AD-VER-3 | One pending application; reapplication from the snapshot | Partial unique `(businessId) WHERE Pending` | `VER-2.I1` | 3.1 (done) | red |
| AD-CAT-1 | Resumable leased ingestion | Partial unique `Running`; lease token | `CAT-1.I1`, `CAT-2.I1` | 4.1 (backlog), 4.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-CAT-2 | Observations immutable, aged at read | Append-only observations; `stale` computed | `CAT-3.I1` | 4.4 (backlog) | red |
| AD-CAT-3 | TRM never invented | `EXCLUDE` on validity ranges; no gap row | `S-FR-CAT-8.f` | 4.4 (backlog) | red |
| AD-INV-1 | One unit per (seller, item, condition) | `UNIQUE (sellerId, catalogEntryId, condition)` | `INV-2.I1` | 5.1 (backlog) | red |
| AD-INV-2 | Reserve and release in the caller's transaction | `tx` parameter; ascending conditional decrement | `INV-1.MEC` | 5.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-INV-3 | Fail-closed purchasability, newer facts only | Seq gate; `AppliedApplicationDecision` | `INV-3.I1`, `S-FR-INV-8.f` | 5.5 (backlog) | red |
| AD-DSC-1 | SQL distance equals the TS reference | One haversine expression; `+ 1e-6` inclusive bound | `DSC-1.I4`, `DSC-2.MEC` | 6.2 (backlog), 6.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-DSC-2 | At most 3 neighbour calls per request | Composition in `listings` | `DSC-2.Q1` | 6.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-ORD-1 | Creation serialized per buyer | `orders:buyer` advisory lock + derived count | `ORD-1.I2` | 7.1 (backlog) | red |
| AD-ORD-2 | Facts set once; expiry derived and materialized once | `IS NULL` predicates; `expiresAt > now` | `ORD-2.MEC`, `ORD-4.MEC` | 7.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-ORD-3 | One visibility predicate; locked comprobante | Visibility SQL; comprobante update predicate | `ORD-3.I3`, `S-FR-ORD-2.f` | 7.1 (backlog), 7.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-COM-1 | One atomic account update + one ledger entry | `UPDATE … RETURNING`; `UNIQUE (businessId, seq)` | `COM-3.I1` | 8.5 (backlog) | red |
| AD-COM-2 | Deduction keyed by `orderId`, priced at the trigger time | Partial unique; rate by `commissionTriggeredAt` | `COM-1.I1` | 8.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-COM-3 | Top-ups have one domain path | `WHERE status='Pending'`; unique TopUp entry | `COM-2.I1` | 8.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-TRD-1 | Offer action = one conditional update | `status`, `turn`, `version`, `expiresAt` predicate | `TRD-2.I3` | 10.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-TRD-2 | Accept serialized per seller | `trd:seller` advisory lock | `TRD-1.MEC` | 10.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-TRD-3 | Completion computed; cancel releases once | `WHERE status='Accepted' AND no confirmation` | `TRD-3.I1` | 10.5 (backlog) | red |
| AD-MSG-1 | Contact messages deterministic and rate-limited | Pure composer; fixed-order advisory locks | `MSG-2.I1`, `MSG-2.MEC` | 9.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-MSG-2 | One conversation per pair; idempotent send | Unique keys; `lastSeq` allocation | `MSG-1.I3` | 9.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-MSG-3 | Read state monotonic | `WHERE "lastReadSeq" < :seq` | `S-FR-MSG-7.f` | 9.6 (backlog) | red |
| AD-COL-1 | Tagged-union entries; collections capped under an owner lock | CHECKs; `col:owner` lock | `COL-3.I2`, `S-FR-COL-1.f` | 11.1 (backlog), 11.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-COL-2 | One prompt per closed order; entries once | `UNIQUE orderId`; `WHERE status='Pending'` | `COL-1.MEC` | 11.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-VAL-1 | Valuation is a pure BigInt function | Pure function; brand types | `VAL-1.I1`, `VAL-1.MEC` | 12.1 (backlog), 12.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-VAL-2 | Trend and history recomputed, no zero division | `roundHalfAwayFromZero`; null baseline | `VAL-2.I1` | 12.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-REP-1 | Business reviews purchase-verified; one per pair | `review_business_iff_verified`; unique pair | `REP-1.I1` | 13.1 (backlog) | red |
| AD-REP-2 | Aggregates from the same snapshot as the list | One statement; `REPEATABLE READ` profile read | `REP-3.MEC` | 13.3 (backlog) | red |
| AD-REP-3 | Hide and unhide conditional and logged | `WHERE hiddenAt IS NULL`; log with snapshots | `REP-2.I2` | 13.2 (backlog) | red |
| AD-SYS-2 rule 10 as refined by R-2 | `audit_events` is append-only and written in the writer's transaction | Grants (`UPDATE`/`DELETE` revoked); `AuditLog.record(tx)` | `SYS-R2` | 1.2 (done) | red |
